LanguageData.FB_PitBurrowEmergence.label: flesh burrow breakthrough
LanguageData.FB_PitBurrowEmergence.letterText: The ground has sunk inward, opening a narrow shaft into the dark. Damp air rises from below, heavy with rot and mould: the smell of flesh that died long ago but never fully came apart.\n\nThis is what has been calling you. A dead flesh colony waits below, and something in its centre is still alive. The call has not faded; it pulls you downward through disgust and dread.
